outcome: Mental Development Index (MDI) scores on the Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development (BSID-CR)
Psychomotor Development Index (PDI) scores on the BSID-CR
cohort: 3,115 mother-infant pairs from the Wuhan Health Baby cohort between September 2013 and October 2018
finding: Aberrant pre-pregnancy BMI (overweight and obese) and GWG (inadequate in mothers with normal pre-pregnancy BMI and excessive in mothers with underweight pre-pregnancy BMI) were associated with lower MDI scores in offspring at 2 years of age.
